rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits beside or just above it. Schedule rows are matched by the printed column header and row order; layout index 0-4 is printed rows 1-5. Amounts print the writer official text: a peso comb plus a 2-slot centavo comb, or one text cell where the sheet has no comb pair. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option, with the Yes box before No by reading order. Left out: the TIN branch (mixed cell with preprinted zeros), the 8A ZIP cell (caption overlaps), item 13A specify (option code), item 14 cents (text box), the MM/DD/YYYY date combs, and rows with no layout key.
